parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) A car windscreen is covered in condensation (small droplets of water). Thermal energy is used to remove the droplets of water. The thermal energy is provided by three resistors on the windscreen. Fig. 6.1 shows two possible circuits for the three resistors. The three resistors are identical. Fig. 6.1

ms.label: 6(a)(i)
ms.text:
any two from:
•
if one resistor fails / breaks the others will still work
•
each resistor gets the full voltage / 12 V or lower (total) resistance or higher current
•
higher power

ms.label: 6(a)(ii)
ms.text:
any two from:
•
evaporation / water evaporates
•
energy (from heater) transfers to particles OR particles gain energy (from the heater)
•
more energetic particles escape (from water / droplet)
•
particles leave from the surface (of the water / droplet)
